map.基于 GB/T 150-2011 内压圆筒壁厚公式：设计壁厚 δ 由设计压力 P: Based on the GB/T 150-2011 internal-pressure cylinder thickness formula: the design thickness delta is computed from design pressure P, inner diameter D, allowable stress [sigma], weld joint factor phi and corrosion allowance C2, for pressure-vessel strength design.
map.💡 计算壁厚 t = P×D / (2×[σ]×φ - P)；设计壁厚 = t: Formula: calculation thickness t = P times D / (2 times [sigma] times phi - P); design thickness = t + C2; nominal thickness = design thickness + material negative deviation C1 (0.3 mm), rounded up.

map.算法（GB 150 内压圆筒）：计算壁厚 δ = P×Di/(2[σ]φ − P: Algorithm (GB 150 internal-pressure cylinder): calculation thickness delta = P times Di/(2[sigma]phi - P); design thickness deltad = delta + C2 (corrosion allowance); nominal thickness rounded deltan = ceil((deltad + C1) times 2)/2, C1=0.3 mm is the material negative deviation, and deltan not less than 3 mm; MAWP = 2[sigma]phi times (deltan-C2-C1)/(Di + deltan-C2-C1); stress check value = P times (Di+deltan-C2)/(2 times (deltan-C2)); stress utilization = check value/[sigma] times 100%; steel weight per meter approx deltan times Di times pi/1e6 (t/m, plate approximation). Applicable for thin-wall range where Di/(2(deltan-C2)) >= .
map.例：P=1.6MPa、Di=1000mm、[σ]=137MPa、φ=0.85、C: Example: P=1.6 MPa, Di=1000 mm, [sigma]=137 MPa, phi=0.85, C2=1.5 mm -> denominator 231.3, calc thickness 6.917 mm, design thickness 8.42 mm, nominal thickness 9.0 mm; MAWP 1.66 MPa, stress check 107.47 MPa, utilization 78.4%, steel about 0.03 t/m, verdict: reasonable. If P=4.0 MPa, Di=800 mm, C2=3.0 mm -> calc thickness 13.98 mm, nominal 17.5 mm, MAWP 4.06 MPa, utilization 82.0%. If weld factor dropped from 0.85 to 0.6 (partial NDT) -> first case denominator 162.8, calc thickness rises to 9.83 mm, nominal 12.0 mm, steel usage up about 33%.
map.焊缝系数 φ 怎么取？: How to take the weld joint factor phi?
map.φ 反映焊接接头强度相对母材的折减：双面焊对接接头 100% 无损检测取 1.0: phi reflects the reduction of joint strength relative to the base metal: double-sided butt weld with 100% NDT is 1.0, partial NDT is 0.85, no NDT is 0.6. GB 150 sets the value by joint type and inspection ratio; lowering the inspection ratio directly raises thickness and cost.
map.为什么算出来还要加腐蚀裕量和负偏差？: Why add corrosion allowance and negative deviation on top of the calculation?
map.计算壁厚只保证承压强度。腐蚀裕量 C₂ 是为介质腐蚀预留的使用寿命厚度（按设计年: The calculation thickness only guarantees pressure-bearing strength. The corrosion allowance C2 reserves thickness for medium corrosion over the service life (by design years times corrosion rate, commonly 1 to 3 mm), and the material negative deviation C1 is the allowed under-tolerance of plate thickness; both must be added beyond the strength calculation, otherwise the vessel loses strength by thinning in later service.
